one_click: First eligible initialization observation under a rule frozen before performance is observed; SIMULATED_ONE_CLICK_FROM_GT; anonymous token; immutable visual anchor; no second click.
runtime: Causal target/NONE decisions without ground truth or future inputs. Independent recording resets motion/native state, not eligible identity memory.
data_policy: Existing assets first. Metadata before bounded lawful TRAIN pilot. Baidu direct before alternative sources for LaSOT person. No full snapshot or duplicate dataset. Final inputs isolated until development freeze.
absence: Evaluate true target absence separately from target-present but unavailable candidates. Never synthesize absence by silently dropping visible positives.
split_policy: Respect official TRAIN/VAL/query/gallery semantics; additional unseen-person/recording/day/camera protocols only where actual metadata permits. Do not infer global identity from local numerical IDs.
primary_metrics: All-visible and candidate-conditional recall; takeover; reacquisition; Recall@FPR<=2%; calibration; valid long-term retention; memory safety.
model_selection: TRAIN-inner only; final inputs cannot select thresholds, memory policies, checkpoints or architectures.
pending_before_fit: Verified dataset metadata, lawful video availability, and identity mapping
Concrete episode/split manifests and initialization rules
Quantitative validation effect/safety thresholds and cluster-bootstrap units
Per-phase storage, time and GPU budget based on actual assets
